messages:
rita_peopleops: Heads up 7 need a comp-band exception for an internal transfer (Marta L.) from SWE-2 -> SWE-3. Manager requests $205k base effective on transfer date 2026-06-10. Current SWE-3 entry is $200k. Also asking to honor original benefits continuity.

omar_recruiter: Marta accepted the internal offer pending official comp uplift. She's currently on payroll and wants transfer effective 06/10 to align with project milestone. No sign-on.

sylvie_manager: Support the uplift. She's been covering SWE-3 duties. Approve transfer early to 06/10 to avoid sprint gap.

devon_comp: Noted. Comp-committee please advise on internal promotion uplift policy (we usually allow up to 5% above midpoint with manager sign-off). This is ~2.5% uplift so should be ok.

comp-committee: For internal promotions, committee approves up to $210k with manager and People Ops sign-off. APPROVED for Marta at $205k. Condition: submit internal promotion form and update HRIS before 06/05 for benefits continuity.

payroll-bot: Payroll note: transfers must be entered in HRIS by 06/05 to ensure correct tax and benefits mapping. If entered after, benefits may lapse and re-enrollment required.

rita_peopleops: Thanks. I'll enter the HRIS change and file the exception record (OA-2026-712). Omar, please update Marta's appointment letter with new base and effective date.

omar_recruiter: Will update and send by EOD. Marta confirmed. :white_check_mark:
